description: Real-user web vitals across the sites, from Faro's lines in Loki.

panels.description: What real browsers reported over the range (Faro), the probes' visits aside. A page load is one TTFB measurement. Vitals are the 75th percentile, rated by web.dev's bands.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"$app"} | kind="measurement" | logfmt | type="web-vitals" | app_environment!="probe" | value_ttfb!="" [$__range]))
sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"$app"} | kind="event" | logfmt | app_environment!="probe" | event_name="session_start" [$__range]))
sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"$app"} | kind="exception" | logfmt | app_environment!="probe" [$__range]))
quantile_over_time(0.75, {service_name=~"$app"} | kind="measurement" | logfmt | type="web-vitals" | app_environment!="probe" | value_lcp!="" | unwrap value_lcp | __error__="" [$__range]) by ()
quantile_over_time(0.75, {service_name=~"$app"} | kind="measurement" | logfmt | type="web-vitals" | app_environment!="probe" | value_inp!="" | unwrap value_inp | __error__="" [$__range]) by ()
quantile_over_time(0.75, {service_name=~"$app"} | kind="measurement" | logfmt | type="web-vitals" | app_environment!="probe" | value_cls!="" | unwrap value_cls | __error__="" [$__range]) by ()
